meals.title: Butternut & chickpea curry
meals.why: Butternut and chickpeas are both on promo; vegetarian and cheap.
method: Add cubed butternut, tomatoes and coconut milk; simmer 25 min.
Stir in chickpeas, heat through, serve with rice.

meals.title: Boerewors braai with baby potatoes
meals.why: Boerewors and baby potatoes are both well down this week.
method: Finish potatoes on the grid, toss in butter and parsley.
